capabilities: Create .kmindz mind maps from the command palette or the file tree
Edit nodes in place with rich text, images, todos, icons, tags and links
Switch between map, split and outline views of the same map
Apply layouts, themes, edge styles and background colors
Import and export .md, .opml, .mm, .xmind, SVG and PNG
extras: Licensing, trial activation, purchase sessions and theme sharing contact KMind services; mind map document contents are not uploaded. Pre-release builds can be installed with BRAT.
motivation: Maps are saved in your vault instead of hidden inside an external cloud workspace, so existing folders, sync, backups and version-control habits keep working.
problem: Mind mapping tools usually keep maps in an external cloud workspace, so maps sit outside the vault's folders, sync, backups and version control.

relations.evidence: move maps between Obsidian, SiYuan, the Web App, and the standalone desktop app
You can also use this repository with BRAT if you want to test a release

summary: Local-first mind mapping plugin that creates and edits .kmindz map files inside the vault, with map, split and outline views.
